summary: Kootenai National Forest lookout site in Lincoln County, MT: firelookout.com dates a cabin and patrol tower to 1929; FFLA and firelookout.com both list it gone.

facts.design: cabin and patrol tower, one date given (1929)

access.note: No source we read says whether the site is open to the public.

events.note: Firelookout.com lists a cabin and a patrol tower under 1929 with no separate dates

evidence.supports: agency and forest: Kootenai National Forest
page gives no account of the site today

survey code 33N-26W-32 in the Kootenai National Forest

notes_for_editor: Only one dated source (firelookout.com, 1929), and it gives the cabin and the patrol tower under one year, so the build history is unclear. The Rex list gives a survey code only. Two web searches found no construction, staffing or removal record. The story sits at the 120-word floor because the evidence is thin.
